events.title: Gold Hits Over Two-week Low As Brent Crude Tops $112 On Supply Concerns
events.description: Gold prices fell over 1 percent to reach their lowest level in more than two weeks on Thursday as investors reacted to escalating Middle East tensions and looked ahead to a series of central bank meetings due next week for direction.

events.title: French Manufacturing Sentiment Highest Since Mid-2022
events.description: French manufacturing confidence rose to its highest level since July 2022 with robust improvement in opinion related to global and foreign order books, survey results from the statistical office INSEE showed Thursday. The manufacturing sentiment index climbed to 105 in October from 101 in the previous month. The score was the highest since July 2022.

events.title: Oil Prices Soar After Drone Attack On Saudi Oilfield
events.description: Oil prices surged on Thursday, approaching a near four-year high reached in May amid renewed concerns over escalating supply risks in the Middle East.

events.title: Yen Rises Amid Risk-off Mood
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday, as Asian stock markets traded lower amid a re-escalation in the Middle East conflict after a deadly attack on a Saudi oil field overnight sent crude oil prices spiking and added to concerns over supply disruptions and global inflationary pressures.

events.title: European Shares Decline Amid Earnings Deluge, Debt Jitters
events.description: European stocks were sharply lower on Thursday as investors digested a slew of mixed earnings and fretted over escalating supply risks in the Middle East.

events.title: Europe Car Sales Growth Strengthens On EV Momentum: ACEA
events.description: Europe's new car registrations growth accelerated in September, driven by the surge in electric car sales, data from the European Automobile Manufacturers' Association, or ACEA, revealed Thursday. New car sales increased 9.3 percent on a yearly basis in September, which was faster than the 4.5 percent rise posted in August.

events.title: Asian Shares Retreat On AI Cost Concerns, Gulf Tensions
events.description: Asian stocks sank to a three-month low on Thursday, with renewed concerns over the financing and profitability of the artificial intelligence boom as well as escalating tensions in West Asia keeping investors on edge.

events.title: Yen Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday.

events.title: Bank Of Korea Keeps Rate On Hold
events.description: The Bank of Korea left its benchmark rate unchanged on Thursday, following two consecutive quarter-point rate hikes and maintained a hawkish stance as inflation is expected to remain above the target level. The seven-member monetary policy board unanimously decided to keep the base rate unchanged at 3.00 percent, as widely expected, on Thursday.

events.title: European Shares On Track For Tepid Open As Houthi Attacks Escalate
events.description: European stocks are seen opening lower on Thursday as investors react to mixed earnings results from U.S. megacap companies and fret over rising borrowing costs amid signs the conflict in the Middle East will not be resolved quickly.

events.title: Indian Shares Open Lower After Attack On Saudi Oilfield
events.description: Indian shares were notably lower in early trade on Thursday as a drone attack on Saudi Aramco's Shaybah oil field as well as another attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, heightened concerns over further disruptions to energy supplies.

events.title: Australian Market Maintains Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is maintaining its early losses in mid-market moves on Thursday after slipping deeper briefly, reversing the gains in the previous session, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling below the 8,800 level, with weakness across most sectors led by in mining and energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Lower
events.description: Asian markets are trading mostly lower on Thursday, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, amid a re-escalation in the Middle East conflict after a deadly attack on a Saudi oil field overnight sent crude oil prices spiking and added to concerns over supply disruptions and global inflationary pressures. Asian markets closed mixed on Wednesday.
